about: The collections within the DAAHO collection, and which items go in each. `pnpm import:sets` creates any collection here that the site does not have yet, with these texts as a first draft for staff to rewrite in the admin, and puts every item that has no collection into the one whose prefix its item ID starts with. It never changes a collection that exists, or an item's collection once set.

sets.title: Asian American Experience at Miami University
sets.summary: Letters and records on Asian students at Miami and the university's ties with Asia, across most of the twentieth century.
sets.holder: Walter Havighurst Special Collections & University Archives, Miami University

sets.title: Race at Miami University
sets.summary: President Upham's letters on Asian students at Miami and his 1937–38 journey through Asia, catalogued by library staff.
sets.holder: Walter Havighurst Special Collections & University Archives, Miami University

sets.title: Asian Festival programs
sets.summary: Program booklets from the Asian Festival in Columbus.

sets.title: Oral histories at Columbus Metropolitan Library
sets.summary: Asian Americans in Ohio talk about immigrating and making their lives here. The recordings play on the library's website.
